title: API Client Delivery

owners.name: riido-contracts
owners.owns: canonical vocabulary, domain policy grammar, lifecycle/deprecation grammar
owners.does_not_own: control-plane handler behavior or client branches

owners.name: riido-control-plane
owners.owns: AI Agent client API sub-DSL, HTTP/SSE implementation, OpenAPI projection handoff, generated-client delivery workflow, release manifest
owners.does_not_own: canonical business meaning outside API projection

owners.name: riido-client
owners.owns: consuming generated React Query code and API usability feedback
owners.does_not_own: OpenAPI SSOT, control-plane codegen, generated-code hand edits

delivery_workflow.package_mode: create_pr=false builds the review artifact without requiring `riido-client` write credentials
delivery_workflow.deliver_mode: create_pr=true opens or updates a riido-client generated handoff PR
delivery_workflow.intentional_failure: This failure is intentional only for `create_pr=true` when cross-repository credentials are absent.

target_branch.rule: target_branch must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+-.+ and must not contain path separators
target_branch.secret_gate: delivery requires branch-name and secret gates before cross-repository write

figma_contexts.rule: menu placement is generated-client consumption context, not endpoint evidence
figma_contexts.must_not_own: client menu labels, ordering, selected state, or route wiring

figma_contexts.rule: active_stream is the generated handoff into SSE when present
figma_contexts.must_not_own: comment box, row layout, right panel, or stopped-row presentation

figma_contexts.rule: assignment_ready is daemon/runtime handoff and must not be rendered as queued_by_busy_agent
figma_contexts.must_not_own: Korean display copy, timestamp wording, avatar, or comment-row layout

figma_contexts.rule: delete can expose running_tasks_force_stopped and stopped_by_agent_deleted
figma_contexts.must_not_own: stopped-row copy, actor label, timestamp wording, hidden action state, avatar, or row layout

figma_contexts.rule: query feeds AI Agent rows in the participant dropdown
figma_contexts.must_not_own: sorting, truncation, max-height, scrollbar width, or checkbox layout

figma_contexts.rule: generated pieces feed device/runtime grouping and daemon controls
figma_contexts.must_not_own: hover popover, stop modal layout, or restart animation rendering

figma_contexts.rule: created_at and updated_at feed list dates and tooltips
figma_contexts.must_not_own: row click, meatball menu, status label copy/color, save enablement, or provider-specific model labels

figma_contexts.rule: fixtures create a normal agent with CreateAgentConfigurationRequest
figma_contexts.must_not_own: workspace selector layout, copied fixture text as SSOT, or app-start helper endpoints

figma_contexts.rule: auth/onboarding screens are not generated-client endpoint evidence for this API
figma_contexts.must_not_own: sign-up/login, terms consent, invite, app download, waitlist, or marketing-consent helpers

runtime_model_catalog.rendering: clients render `RuntimeRecord.models`; model labels stay runtime-scoped display data rather than enum members
runtime_model_catalog.fixture_rule: Fixture records must not include model defaults or `model_id`; clients rely on the omitted-`model_id` defaulting rule.

required_doc_phrases: This failure is intentional only for `create_pr=true`
model labels stay runtime-scoped display data rather than enum members
forbidden_doc_phrases: until the canonical contracts model-catalog policy
promotes them; clients derive the selected model

source_checks.name: workflow-token-boundary
contains: target_branch must be the Riido work branchName

loop.observation: The API client delivery document repeated generated-client workflow, branch, Figma context, model-catalog, and permission rules as prose while executable generators and manifests already existed.
loop.hypothesis: A delivery manifest can generate the reader and verify each frontend handoff claim against workflow, generator, projection, risk, and public-surface evidence.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the delivery manifest and run the apiclientdelivery verifier in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks source anchors, required reader phrases, forbidden stale phrases, linked source manifests, workflow token gates, and generated doc freshness.
loop.retrospective: This keeps generated-client delivery reviewable without making the prose document a second source of truth.
